notes.title: Board the spaceship to Discovery!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce we are expanding the Hidden Through Time franchise with the next installment; [b]Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery[/b]!

[previewyoutube=RdL6dcTADFw;full][/previewyoutube]
Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery is coming soon to PC (Steam), Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Mobile (Android, iOS).

Hidden Through Time 2: Discovery is a cozy hidden object game that has you searching for hidden objects in hand-drawn, interactive landscapes. Ignite your imagination, unleash your inner artist with the editor and share your masterpieces with the world!

[h2]Key features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Relaxing Gameplay[/b]
A relaxing and cozy experience is ensured as the game doesn’t feature timers or similar mechanics to put pressure on the player. They’re able to enjoy the game at their own speed.

[*] [b]Map Editor[/b]
Players have access to assets from all three eras (Noir, Victorian, and Sci-Fi), giving the ability to bring their imagination to life in the Map Editor, where creations can be shared with the community.

[*] [b]Reality shift[/b]
Seen in the previous game, Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic, the Reality Shift feature makes a return. This allows players to explore a whole host of new objects as they can shift between time and season, giving more depth to each map, enabling more space for storytelling within one map. 
[/list]
[h2]Wishlist on Steam![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094680

notes.title: Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Start your magical adventure now! [/h2]

We are very excited to announce [b]Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic is OUT NOW on Steam and GOG[/b]! Releases on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and mobile coming soon.

[previewyoutube=L-QeQ3iAckE;full][/previewyoutube]
Join Clicky on a new, enchanted adventure in Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic! This charming 2D hidden object game is sure to delight with its playful tone, cozy vibes and endless fun. Search for all the hidden objects scattered around beautiful hand-drawn worlds, and unlock more as you go. With both a single player campaign and an online mode where you can create your own dreamworld, the adventure never ends!

[h3]Purchase Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic now and enjoy a 10% discount.[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2304640/Hidden_Through_Time_2_Myths__Magic/

[h2]Key Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Campaign[/b]
Set out on a journey through four magical eras, uncovering all the items hidden within. Find objects to advance through the stages and explore the storyline of each era – who knows what secrets you’ll uncover next!

[*] [b]Reality shift[/b]
Master the power of time with the brand-new Reality Shift feature, adding an extra dimension to your hidden object experience. Shift from Day to Night, Summer to Winter, … and explore maps in multiple states. But keep an eye out for those objects only present in one or the other!

[*] [b]Increased interactions[/b]
Interact with pretty much anything and feel the map come to life! Everything you click on gives some sort of audible or visible feedback. Go out and discover what your favorite interaction is. And click on the goat, you'll be amazed by it's capabilities. 

[*] [b]Secret objectives[/b]
Test your acumen with this new type of objective! Find them all and unlock the final challenge of every era. Be wary though, as these objectives do not have a hint, but there are a few clues to help you. Maps contain only one secret objective.

[*] [b]Create and share[/b] 
Have a creative streak? The improved Architect Mode lets you build and share your own unique experiences with greater ease than ever before! Show off your map-making skills and see how your creations stack up against those of others. Create your own maps in the Architect and share them with the community to play!
[/list]
Adventure is but a Click(y) away! Start yours now!

Join the official [url=www.discord.gg/JQjaKTn76n]Hidden Through Time Discord[/url] to learn more and chat with the development team - and be sure to follow us on social media for all the latest news and updates.
[url=www.facebook.com/Rogueside]Facebook[/url]
[url=www.twitter.com/RoguesideGames]Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Hidden Through Time: Road to Rome DLC OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641672/6e4cf2da1cd129c7cf7276c324d3e699ff05c804.png[/img]
[h1]Road to Rome DLC is OUT NOW! [/h1]

Carpe Diem, Timewalkers! 🍎

Have you conquered the viking clans in the North? Learned all the Legends of the samurai and dojos? And are you hankering to explore a new timeline with Clicky? Well, today is the day!

Accompany Clicky in his adventure through the Ancient Roman Empire! Explore the streets of the city, hear the roar of the crowd and enjoy the amazing architecture!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1536700/Hidden_Through_Time__Road_to_Rome/

The Road to Rome DLC adds ten new campaign levels and over 300 new objects, characters and creatures for level creators to make amazing levels with!

The Roman Empire – an ancient empire, centered on the city of Rome. Not only known for their ruthless conquering of the world, but also for their amazing architecture, intriguing mythology and powerful emperors. 

In Hidden Through Time – Road to Rome you will accompany Clicky on his adventure through the streets of Rome! Hear the roar of the arena, march into battle with the troops and earn the favor of the gods! Observe your surroundings with care and discover the secrets hidden in plain sight.

This DLC includes ten new levels ranging from Gaul settlements to the monumental Colosseum! It also features more than 300 new Roman Empire themed objects and characters, which will be in the level editor upon purchase!

People who don’t own this DLC will still be able to play through user created maps that use objects from the Road to Rome DLC.

Recline in your comfortable lectus, grab an amphora of your favorite drink and prepare to make yourself comfortable. 

After all, Rome wasn’t built in a day.

notes.content:
